scripts.text: Just walk away.
scripts.translation: 直接离开

scripts.text: ^0000FFEden Group^000000 missions?
How can I be a member of the ^0000FFEden Group^000000?
scripts.translation: 如何成为^0000FF乐园团^000000的成员？

scripts.text:
::The Eden Group Missions
::are basically missions
::requested by
::people from all around the kingdom.
::We just categorize them.
scripts.translation:
::乐园团的任务
::基本上是王国各地人们
::提出的委托。
::我们只是负责分类。

scripts.text:
::In the Eden Group,
::we sorted out the missions
::according to the level of difficulty.
::According to this level,
::you can find
::missions that
::suit you.
scripts.translation:
::乐园团会按照任务难度
::对委托进行分类。
::您可以根据等级，
::寻找适合自己的任务。

scripts.text:
::When you are done,
::you can come back
::to the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::完成后，
::您可以回到
::任务板。

scripts.text:
::Then you will be
::rewarded!!
::Simple, isn't it!!
::No commission required!!
scripts.translation:
::然后您将获得
::奖励！！
::很简单，不是吗！！
::无需手续费！！

scripts.text:
::You can become a member
::of the Eden Group
::to ^0000FFLaime Evenor^000000,
::who is waiting on the 1st floor.
scripts.translation:
::向在一楼等候的
::^0000FF莱梅·艾文诺^000000申请
::加入乐园团。

scripts.text:
::If you become a member,
::you will get an
::"^006400Eden Group Mark^000000".
::Then you will be able
::to see the mission board.
scripts.translation:
::成为成员后，
::您会获得
::“^006400乐园团徽章^000000”，
::之后就能查看任务板了。

scripts.text: You must be within level 86-90 to accept these missions.
scripts.translation: 您的等级必须在86-90级之间才能接受这些任务。
